column3: “In the hand of Ithamar” preserves the hand image rendered “under the direction of.”
“According to the mouth of the LORD, by the hand of Moses” preserves both body images behind “at the command … through Moses.”
“According to the mouth of the LORD” preserves the speaking image rendered “at the LORD’s command.”
“According to the mouth of the LORD, by the hand of Moses” preserves both body images behind “at the LORD’s command through Moses.”
The final clause repeats the counting expression, rather than reducing the ending to “as the LORD had commanded Moses.”
